articles.title: Once-Weekly Onswik Approval And Alopecia Win Could Be A Game Changer For Eli Lilly (LLY)
articles.excerpt: Eli Lilly recently secured U.S. FDA approvals for Onswik, a once-weekly basal insulin for adults with type 2 diabetes, and expanded Olumiant’s label to treat adolescents 12 and older with severe alopecia areata, supported by large Phase 3 programs showing efficacy and consistent safety profiles.
